delivery_rule.en: One box every two months, packed with two months of goods. Delivered on its own it pays its way on every plan except: Every two months after that on the 12-month plan. Those boxes ride inside another Afya box delivered to the same household (one delivery, no extra delivery cost) or are collected in store. Monthly delivery is not offered: a one-month basket cannot carry packing and delivery.
delivery_rule.sw: Sanduku moja kila baada ya miezi miwili, lenye bidhaa za miezi miwili. Likiletwa peke yake linalipa gharama zake kwenye kila mpango isipokuwa: Kila miezi miwili baada ya hapo kwenye mpango wa miezi 12. Masanduku hayo husafirishwa ndani ya sanduku lingine la Afya linaloletwa kwa kaya hiyohiyo (usafirishaji mmoja, bila gharama ya ziada ya usafirishaji) au huchukuliwa dukani. Kuleta kila mwezi hakutolewi: kikapu cha mwezi mmoja hakiwezi kubeba gharama za kufunga na kusafirisha.

who.en:
Binti is the box for a teenage girl, from about 10 years old, around her first period, to 18. It brings what puberty asks for, so she is never caught at school without a pad: day and night pads for two cycles, sealable bags for used pads, an antiperspirant, a gentle face wash, soap, toothpaste and a toothbrush, body lotion, a pocket hand sanitiser and a mosquito repellent. The first box adds a hot-water bottle for cramps, a cycle diary with a printed guide, and a treated net.

Why. WHO asks that menstruation be treated as a health issue, not only a hygiene one. In a 2024 study of 486 schoolgirls in Mwanza, 16% had missed school at their last period and three in four had period pain (figures from the code; the article could not be re-opened). The period items are kept modest: the amounts cover a typical cycle for a girl, and Afya Siku is the separate, full period box for women.

Iron. Iron-deficiency anaemia is among the leading causes of ill health in adolescents (WHO). Where 20% or more of women are anaemic, WHO recommends intermittent iron and folic acid for menstruating women and adolescent girls; Tanzania’s 2022 survey found 37% of women anaemic (fact sheet seen in a search result only). The weekly tablet is a medicine: it is supplied by the partner pharmacy on its advice and is not in the box price, like ibuprofen for cramps and benzoyl peroxide gel for acne.

HPV. WHO makes HPV vaccination a priority for girls aged 9 to 14. Tanzania gives one free dose to girls at 9 through the public programme (UNICEF, search result); the box reminds families who missed it.

When to see a clinic. Bleeding for more than seven days, soaking a pad every hour, pain that stops her going to school even with tablets, no period by 15, or acne that scars.
who.sw:
Binti ni sanduku la msichana balehe, kuanzia takriban miaka 10, karibu na hedhi yake ya kwanza, hadi miaka 18. Linaleta kile ambacho balehe inahitaji, ili asikutwe shuleni bila pedi: pedi za mchana na za usiku za mizunguko miwili, mifuko inayofungika kwa pedi zilizotumika, roll-on ya kuzuia jasho, sabuni laini ya uso, sabuni, dawa ya meno na mswaki, losheni ya mwili, kitakasa mikono cha mfukoni na dawa ya kufukuza mbu. Sanduku la kwanza linaongeza chupa ya maji ya moto kwa maumivu, daftari la mzunguko lenye mwongozo uliochapishwa, na chandarua chenye dawa.

Kwa nini. WHO inataka hedhi ichukuliwe kuwa suala la afya, si la usafi tu. Katika utafiti wa mwaka 2024 wa wasichana 486 wa shule Mwanza, asilimia 16 walikosa shule wakati wa hedhi yao iliyopita na watatu kati ya wanne walikuwa na maumivu ya hedhi (takwimu kutoka kwenye msimbo; makala haikuweza kufunguliwa upya). Bidhaa za hedhi ni za kiasi: kiasi kinatosha mzunguko wa kawaida wa msichana, na Afya Siku ndilo sanduku kamili tofauti la hedhi kwa wanawake.

Madini ya chuma. Upungufu wa damu unaotokana na ukosefu wa madini ya chuma ni miongoni mwa sababu kuu za afya duni kwa vijana (WHO). Pale asilimia 20 au zaidi ya wanawake wana upungufu wa damu, WHO inapendekeza madini ya chuma na foliki kwa vipindi kwa wanawake na wasichana balehe wanaopata hedhi; utafiti wa Tanzania wa 2022 ulionyesha asilimia 37 ya wanawake wana upungufu wa damu (karatasi iliyoonekana kwenye matokeo ya utafutaji tu). Kidonge cha kila wiki ni dawa: hutolewa na famasia mshirika kwa ushauri wake na hakimo kwenye bei ya sanduku, kama ilivyo ibuprofen kwa maumivu na jeli ya benzoyl peroxide kwa chunusi.

HPV. WHO inaweka chanjo ya HPV kuwa kipaumbele kwa wasichana wa miaka 9 hadi 14. Tanzania hutoa dozi moja bure kwa wasichana wa miaka 9 kupitia mpango wa serikali (UNICEF, matokeo ya utafutaji); sanduku huzikumbusha familia zilizoikosa.

Wakati wa kwenda kliniki. Damu zaidi ya siku saba, pedi kujaa kila saa, maumivu yanayomzuia kwenda shule hata akitumia vidonge, kutopata hedhi hadi miaka 15, au chunusi zinazoacha makovu.

clinic_line.en: Whether she takes iron, a pain tablet or an acne gel, and at what dose, is decided by her clinic or the partner pharmacist; Afya does not sell medicines. Periods that last more than seven days, soak a pad every hour, or bring pain that keeps her from school need a clinic.
clinic_line.sw: Kama atatumia madini ya chuma, kidonge cha maumivu au jeli ya chunusi, na kwa dozi gani, huamuliwa na kliniki yake au mfamasia mshirika; Afya haiuzi dawa. Hedhi inayodumu zaidi ya siku saba, inayojaza pedi kila saa, au yenye maumivu yanayomzuia kwenda shule inahitaji kliniki.

label.sw: Sanduku la kwanza · hedhi za kwanza

why.en: Most girls in Tanzania start their periods between about 11 and 14, often without warning at school. Running out of pads is one of the main reasons girls miss lessons: a Mwanza study of 486 schoolgirls found 16% missed school at their last period. A pad is changed every four to six hours, so about three a day over a five-day period. The box carries two cycles; Afya Siku is the full period box for older women.
why.sw: Wasichana wengi Tanzania huanza hedhi kati ya miaka 11 na 14, mara nyingi bila kutarajia wakiwa shuleni. Kukosa pedi ni mojawapo ya sababu kuu za wasichana kukosa masomo: utafiti wa wasichana 486 wa shule Mwanza ulionyesha asilimia 16 walikosa shule wakati wa hedhi yao iliyopita. Pedi hubadilishwa kila saa nne hadi sita, hivyo takriban tatu kwa siku kwa hedhi ya siku tano. Sanduku lina pedi za mizunguko miwili; Afya Siku ndilo sanduku kamili la hedhi kwa wanawake wakubwa.

why.en: Many school toilets have no bin, so girls carry a used pad home or hide it. A small sealable bag lets her wrap and carry it discreetly and dispose of it at home, never in the pit or flush toilet (UNICEF guidance on menstrual health and hygiene).

name.sw: Chupa ya maji ya moto kwa maumivu ya hedhi

why.en: Period pain is common in the first years: three in four Mwanza schoolgirls reported it. Warmth on the lower belly is a simple first comfort, before or with a pain tablet. One, in the first box; filled with hot, not boiling, water and always in a cover or towel.
why.sw: Maumivu ya hedhi ni ya kawaida katika miaka ya kwanza: wasichana watatu kati ya wanne wa shule Mwanza waliripoti maumivu. Joto kwenye tumbo la chini ni faraja ya kwanza rahisi, kabla ya au pamoja na kidonge cha maumivu. Moja, kwenye sanduku la kwanza; ijazwe maji ya moto yasiyochemka na iwe ndani ya kifuniko au taulo kila mara.

items.qty_formula: 1 per girl; lasts years

why.en: Early cycles are irregular. Writing down the first day, the flow and any pain shows her what is normal for her, helps her be ready for the next period, and gives a clinic the facts if something is wrong: bleeding longer than seven days, soaking a pad every hour, or no period by 15. The notebook comes in the first box with Afya’s printed guide.
why.sw: Mizunguko ya mwanzo haina mpangilio. Kuandika siku ya kwanza, wingi wa damu na maumivu yoyote humwonyesha kipi ni kawaida kwake, humsaidia kujiandaa kwa hedhi ijayo, na huipa kliniki taarifa kama kuna tatizo: damu zaidi ya siku saba, pedi kujaa kila saa, au kutopata hedhi hadi miaka 15. Daftari linakuja kwenye sanduku la kwanza pamoja na mwongozo uliochapishwa wa Afya.

why.en: Underarm odour begins with puberty, often before a teenager notices it, and it is a common cause of teasing at school. An antiperspirant roll-on once a day on clean, dry skin controls both sweat and smell. Roll-ons are used instead of sprays: less is inhaled and a 50 ml bottle lasts about a month.
why.sw: Harufu ya kwapani huanza na balehe, mara nyingi kabla kijana hajaitambua, na ni chanzo cha kawaida cha kudhihakiwa shuleni. Roll-on ya kuzuia jasho mara moja kwa siku kwenye ngozi safi na kavu hudhibiti jasho na harufu. Roll-on hutumika badala ya spray: kidogo huvutwa puani na chupa ya ml 50 hudumu takriban mwezi mmoja.

items.qty_formula: 1 × 50 ml lasts about a month at one use a day × 2 months

why.en: Most teenagers get some acne as oil glands enlarge in puberty. Washing the face twice a day with a mild cleanser and lukewarm water, without scrubbing or squeezing spots, is the first step and is enough for mild spots. Acne that leaves scars, is painful or has not improved after two months of care needs a clinician.
why.sw: Vijana wengi hupata chunusi kiasi tezi za mafuta zinapokua wakati wa balehe. Kuosha uso mara mbili kwa siku kwa sabuni laini na maji ya uvuguvugu, bila kusugua wala kukamua chunusi, ndiyo hatua ya kwanza na inatosha kwa chunusi chache. Chunusi zinazoacha makovu, zinazouma au ambazo hazijapungua baada ya miezi miwili ya utunzaji zinahitaji mtaalamu wa afya.

items.qty_formula: about 0.5 ml a wash × 2 washes a day × 60 days = 60 ml

why.en: Puberty switches on the sweat glands of the armpits and groin, and bacteria on that sweat make body odour. A daily wash with soap and water is the main control. A plain bar is enough; it does not need to be antibacterial.
why.sw: Balehe huwasha tezi za jasho za kwapani na kinenani, na bakteria kwenye jasho hilo husababisha harufu ya mwili. Kuoga kila siku kwa sabuni na maji ndiyo njia kuu ya kuidhibiti. Kipande cha kawaida kinatosha; hakihitaji kuwa cha kuua vijidudu.

items.qty_formula: 2 showers a day × 60 days × about 4 g ≈ 480 g (planning assumption)

why.en: WHO recommends brushing twice a day with a fluoride toothpaste of 1,000–1,500 ppm. Teenagers snack and drink sugary sodas more than younger children, and gum bleeding is common in puberty; fluoride and careful brushing protect both teeth and gums. Spit out after brushing; do not rinse.
why.sw: WHO inapendekeza kupiga mswaki mara mbili kwa siku kwa dawa ya meno yenye floraidi ya ppm 1,000–1,500. Vijana hula vitafunio na kunywa soda zenye sukari zaidi kuliko watoto wadogo, na fizi kutoa damu ni jambo la kawaida wakati wa balehe; floraidi na kupiga mswaki kwa uangalifu hulinda meno na fizi. Tema baada ya kupiga mswaki; usisukutue.

items.qty_formula: about 1 g a brushing × 2 a day × 60 days = 120 g

why.en: Daily washing and the dry season dry the skin of the legs and arms. A plain lotion after the evening shower keeps it supple; it is a comfort item, chosen fragrance-light, with no lightening ingredients.

why.en: Teenagers are outdoors in the evening, studying or at sport, before they are under a net. WHO’s core malaria protection is the insecticide-treated net; a repellent covers the evening hours. Use a product whose label states the active ingredient.

why.en: Periods add iron losses to the iron needs of a growing body, and iron-deficiency anaemia is among the leading causes of ill health in adolescents (WHO). Where 20% or more of women are anaemic, WHO recommends intermittent iron and folic acid for menstruating women and adolescent girls; in Tanzania 37% of women were anaemic in 2022 (survey fact sheet, search result only). One tablet a week, if the clinic or pharmacist agrees. Not priced in the box.
why.sw: Hedhi huongeza upotevu wa madini ya chuma juu ya mahitaji ya mwili unaokua, na upungufu wa damu unaotokana na ukosefu wa madini ya chuma ni miongoni mwa sababu kuu za afya duni kwa vijana (WHO). why.en: Many school toilets have no bin, so girls carry a used pad home or hide it. A small sealable bag lets her wrap and carry it discreetly and dispose of it at home, never in the pit or flush toilet (UNICEF guidance on menstrual health and hygiene).
why.sw: Vyoo vingi vya shule havina pipa, hivyo wasichana hubeba pedi iliyotumika nyumbani au kuificha. Mfuko mdogo unaofungika humwezesha kuifunga na kuibeba kwa siri na kuitupa nyumbani, kamwe si chooni (mwongozo wa UNICEF kuhusu afya na usafi wa hedhi).

why.en: Underarm odour begins with puberty, often before a teenager notices it, and it is a common cause of teasing at school. An antiperspirant roll-on once a day on clean, dry skin controls both sweat and smell. Roll-ons are used instead of sprays: less is inhaled and a 50 ml bottle lasts about a month.
why.sw: Harufu ya kwapani huanza na balehe, mara nyingi kabla kijana hajaitambua, na ni chanzo cha kawaida cha kudhihakiwa shuleni. Roll-on ya kuzuia jasho mara moja kwa siku kwenye ngozi safi na kavu hudhibiti jasho na harufu. Roll-on hutumika badala ya spray: kidogo huvutwa puani na chupa ya ml 50 hudumu takriban mwezi mmoja.

items.qty_formula: 1 × 50 ml lasts about a month at one use a day × 2 months

why.en: Most teenagers get some acne as oil glands enlarge in puberty. Washing the face twice a day with a mild cleanser and lukewarm water, without scrubbing or squeezing spots, is the first step and is enough for mild spots. Acne that leaves scars, is painful or has not improved after two months of care needs a clinician.
why.sw: Vijana wengi hupata chunusi kiasi tezi za mafuta zinapokua wakati wa balehe. Kuosha uso mara mbili kwa siku kwa sabuni laini na maji ya uvuguvugu, bila kusugua wala kukamua chunusi, ndiyo hatua ya kwanza na inatosha kwa chunusi chache. Chunusi zinazoacha makovu, zinazouma au ambazo hazijapungua baada ya miezi miwili ya utunzaji zinahitaji mtaalamu wa afya.

why.en: Puberty switches on the sweat glands of the armpits and groin, and bacteria on that sweat make body odour. A daily wash with soap and water is the main control. A plain bar is enough; it does not need to be antibacterial.
why.sw: Balehe huwasha tezi za jasho za kwapani na kinenani, na bakteria kwenye jasho hilo husababisha harufu ya mwili. Kuoga kila siku kwa sabuni na maji ndiyo njia kuu ya kuidhibiti. Kipande cha kawaida kinatosha; hakihitaji kuwa cha kuua vijidudu.

why.en: WHO recommends brushing twice a day with a fluoride toothpaste of 1,000–1,500 ppm. Teenagers snack and drink sugary sodas more than younger children, and gum bleeding is common in puberty; fluoride and careful brushing protect both teeth and gums. Spit out after brushing; do not rinse.
why.sw: WHO inapendekeza kupiga mswaki mara mbili kwa siku kwa dawa ya meno yenye floraidi ya ppm 1,000–1,500. Vijana hula vitafunio na kunywa soda zenye sukari zaidi kuliko watoto wadogo, na fizi kutoa damu ni jambo la kawaida wakati wa balehe; floraidi na kupiga mswaki kwa uangalifu hulinda meno na fizi. Tema baada ya kupiga mswaki; usisukutue.

why.en: Teenagers are outdoors in the evening, studying or at sport, before they are under a net. WHO’s core malaria protection is the insecticide-treated net; a repellent covers the evening hours. Use a product whose label states the active ingredient.
why.sw: Vijana huwa nje jioni, wakijisomea au michezoni, kabla ya kulala ndani ya chandarua. Kinga kuu ya malaria kwa mujibu wa WHO ni chandarua chenye dawa; dawa ya kufukuza mbu hulinda saa za jioni. Tumia bidhaa ambayo lebo yake inaonyesha kiambato hai.

name.en: Weekly iron and folic acid (partner pharmacy, on advice)
name.sw: Madini ya chuma na foliki kila wiki (famasia mshirika, kwa ushauri)

why.en: Periods add iron losses to the iron needs of a growing body, and iron-deficiency anaemia is among the leading causes of ill health in adolescents (WHO). Where 20% or more of women are anaemic, WHO recommends intermittent iron and folic acid for menstruating women and adolescent girls; in Tanzania 37% of women were anaemic in 2022 (survey fact sheet, search result only). One tablet a week, if the clinic or pharmacist agrees. Not priced in the box.
why.sw: Hedhi huongeza upotevu wa madini ya chuma juu ya mahitaji ya mwili unaokua, na upungufu wa damu unaotokana na ukosefu wa madini ya chuma ni miongoni mwa sababu kuu za afya duni kwa vijana (WHO). Pale asilimia 20 au zaidi ya wanawake wana upungufu wa damu, WHO inapendekeza madini ya chuma na foliki kwa vipindi kwa wanawake na wasichana balehe wanaopata hedhi; Tanzania asilimia 37 ya wanawake walikuwa na upungufu wa damu mwaka 2022 (karatasi ya utafiti, matokeo ya utafutaji tu). Kidonge kimoja kwa wiki, kama kliniki au mfamasia amekubali. Haina bei ndani ya sanduku.

items.qty_formula: 1 tablet a week × 8.7 weeks ≈ 9; dose and product set by the clinic or pharmacist

name.en: Ibuprofen for period pain (partner pharmacy, on advice)
name.sw: Ibuprofen kwa maumivu ya hedhi (famasia mshirika, kwa ushauri)

why.en: An anti-inflammatory such as ibuprofen, taken with food at the start of the pain, works better than paracetamol for period cramps (Cochrane review, as cited in the code). Pain that keeps her off school even with tablets needs a clinic. Supplied by the partner pharmacy only; not priced in the box.
why.sw: Dawa ya kupunguza uvimbe kama ibuprofen, ikimezwa pamoja na chakula mwanzoni mwa maumivu, hufanya kazi vizuri zaidi kuliko paracetamol kwa maumivu ya hedhi (mapitio ya Cochrane, kama yalivyonukuliwa kwenye msimbo). Maumivu yanayomzuia kwenda shule hata akitumia vidonge yanahitaji kliniki. Hutolewa na famasia mshirika tu; haina bei ndani ya sanduku.

why.en: For spots that a gentle wash alone does not settle, a thin layer of benzoyl peroxide 2.5% once a day is the usual first treatment; it takes six to eight weeks to work and can bleach fabric. It is a pharmacy product: the partner pharmacist decides whether it suits, and it is not priced in the box.
why.sw: Kwa chunusi ambazo sabuni laini pekee haizipunguzi, safu nyembamba ya benzoyl peroxide 2.5% mara moja kwa siku ndiyo tiba ya kwanza ya kawaida; huchukua wiki sita hadi nane kufanya kazi na inaweza kufifisha rangi ya nguo. Ni bidhaa ya famasia: mfamasia mshirika huamua kama inafaa, na haina bei ndani ya sanduku.

services_note.en: growth-check: height, weight, BMI and blood pressure at the Afya Check in store, free. first-period-talk: a private talk in store with a female adviser, with a parent if she wishes, at the first box, free. hpv-reminder: a reminder of the free public HPV dose for girls who missed it at 9, free. dental-check: a six-monthly check-up with a partner dentist as an add-on; no quote yet (R7). Anaemia testing is for the clinic: the basic Afya Check has no finger-prick test (R2).
services_note.sw: growth-check: urefu, uzito, BMI na shinikizo la damu kwenye Afya Check dukani, bure. first-period-talk: mazungumzo ya faragha dukani na mshauri mwanamke, pamoja na mzazi akipenda, katika sanduku la kwanza, bure. hpv-reminder: kikumbusho cha dozi ya bure ya HPV ya serikali kwa wasichana walioikosa wakiwa na miaka 9, bure. dental-check: uchunguzi wa meno kila miezi sita kwa daktari wa meno mshirika kama nyongeza; bado hakuna bei (R7). Kipimo cha upungufu wa damu ni cha kliniki: Afya Check ya msingi haina kipimo cha tone la damu (R2).

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the box goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for the 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing (S 3,500 · M 5,000) and one delivery (3,500) included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 shares: brand 78%, pharm 72%, own 50%) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0.
pricing_rule.note: Medicines are listed but sold by the licensed partner pharmacy and not priced in the box (B4). The premium and luxury items are their own line at shelf price, outside the saving.
